issues.title: Cambodia protests Thai installation of Buddha statue in Anlong Veng
issues.title_en: Cambodia protests Thai installation of Buddha statue in Anlong Veng
issues.summary: PHNOM PENH: The Cambodian government has lodged a strong formal protest against what it described as "continued violations of Cambodia's sovereignty and territorial integrity" by Thai forces along the border, most recently through the installation of a large Buddha statue in Oddar Meanchey province.
